title: The Tailor's Golden Needle
intro: Mrs Thimbleby, the village tailor, lost her golden needle the night before the Harvest Fair. Without it, nobody gets a costume!
reveal: Pip the magpie took it! Magpies love shiny things, and Pip tucked it into the {pile} haystack.

title: Grandpa Joe's Compass
intro: The needle fell out of Grandpa Joe's old compass. Now he can't find his way home from the far fields!
reveal: It was the wind! Last night's storm blew the loose needle across the farm and into the {pile} haystack.

title: The Knitting Needle Caper
intro: Granny Rose was knitting the world's longest scarf when one of her needles vanished.
reveal: Biscuit the barn cat ran off with the yarn, and the needle went with it, all the way to the {pile} haystack.

title: The Silent Record Player
intro: The barn dance starts tonight, but the record player's needle is gone. No needle, no music, no dance!
reveal: Young Ollie hid it so he could practise his drums in peace. He buried it in the {pile} haystack.

title: The Mayor's Lucky Pin
intro: The mayor's lucky silver pin disappeared an hour before her big speech at the fair.
reveal: Gertrude the goat nibbled the mayor's hat, and the pin dropped out by the {pile} haystack.
